title: The Greater Glory of the New Covenant
summary_text: The Corinthians themselves are Paul's letter of recommendation, a letter from Christ written on human hearts by God's Spirit. This hope makes him bold, and he says the veil covering hearts is removed when someone turns to the Lord.
